done_when: When a cold read or review loop stops, forge read, forge close, forge land and forge next print a ready-to-ask question that names the item in plain words and what it delivers, lists each open blocking note or finding as one plain sentence saying what goes wrong for whom, and says what accept, narrow and split would each concretely do for this item, and the guide tells the coordinator to ask exactly that

findings.body: Raise: Not done. On a stopped review with both blocking findings and advice, the question lists only blocking findings and says Accept will “dismiss these findings” (`src/forge/review.py:218-222`). But `forge close --resolve accept` dismisses every finding in the review, including the advice (`src/forge/close.py:93-99`). The owner is therefore given an inaccurate account of what Accept does for that item.
findings.title: Not done: When a cold read or review loop stops, forge read, forge close, forge land and forge next print a ready-to-ask question that names

findings.body: Raise: Test. The named close and read proofs each create only one blocking finding in the stopped round (`tests/test_close_holds_after_three_blocked_reviews.py:80-81`; `tests/test_reads_wait_for_a_loop_choice.py:63-64`). Both would pass if a question printed only the first blocker. A normal stop with two open blockers would then omit one problem the owner needs to decide about, so the explicit “each open” behavior has no effective command-level test.
findings.title: Not done: test every open blocker in a stopped question

findings.body: Raise: Gate. The standard says, “When you present options, lead with the one you recommend, its reason and how sure you are.” The new ready-to-ask question always presents Accept first, then Narrow and Split, with no recommendation or reason (`src/forge/story.py:1010-1014`). The shipped guide also requires the coordinator to ask that text exactly (`src/forge/templates/skill.md:1240-1242`), conflicting with its existing instruction to put the recommended option first (`src/forge/templates/skill.md:56-57,73-74`).
findings.title: Standard: Give one recommendation

stop.reason: Coordinator decision under the owner's bar (Gain 2, Work 2, Harm 1): forge next shows only the document error while a stopped story's draft is malformed; fixing the draft brings the question back. Recorded as lived-with.

why: When a cold read or review loop stops, the owner is asked to accept, narrow or split with no context; with many items in parallel they can't tell what the item is or what was flagged
